content.text:
The campaign is finished. I submitted **index 28** (Sb 0.67 / Y 0.33) as the best composition, with a measured EQE of 0.0035 %.

I had 3 merit measurements and used all of them. I made no XRD measurements, so which crystal phases are present was never checked.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 17 | 0.32 | 0.00050 |
| 26 | 0.61 | 0.00151 |
| 28 | 0.67 | 0.00349 |

EQE went up steadily with Sb content, and index 28 is the most Sb-rich composition in the library. The Y-rich compositions are probably poor because their oxides absorb little light at 3.2 eV. I measured index 26 to look for a peak near the Sb-rich yttrium antimonate phase (Sb 0.625), but it came out lower than 28.

With only three points and none between Sb 0.35 and 0.58, I can't rule out a higher value in that gap. Still, the trend puts the best composition at the Sb-rich end. All the EQE values are very small, so none of these films is a strong photoanode.
